problem_statement: In the Meridian Ops Console (a StartBootstrap SB Admin dashboard), the DataTable card hosts an 'Operations review queue' workflow: a tab filter (Open escalations / Finance ready / Audit complete) that switches the active review panel and keeps a live readout in sync ('Now reviewing: <queue> · N items in queue'), plus a four-tile summary strip (Open escalations, Finance ready, Audit complete, Records in queue). This queue workflow is a shared feature that appears in the DataTable card on both the Dashboard (index) and the Tables page. A recent regression damaged the workflow three ways: (1) the summary tile row was laid out as a single fixed-width non-wrapping strip, so on a 390px mobile viewport it pushes the whole dashboard into horizontal overflow; (2) the workflow was dropped from the Tables page, so the queue no longer appears there; (3) the tab filter's live readout was wired to a stale snapshot, so switching tabs flips the active tab and panel but leaves the readout frozen on 'Open escalations'. Repair the workflow so the tile row wraps with no mobile overflow, the queue workflow is present in the DataTable card on both the Dashboard and the Tables page, and switching tabs updates the live readout to match the selected queue — while leaving the KPI cards, chart cards, DataTable, sidebar toggle, top nav, and the source build pipeline exactly as they are.
required_content: Fix the layout so the 390px mobile dashboard has no horizontal overflow: the summary tile row must wrap instead of forcing a fixed-width strip.
Restore the Operations review queue workflow inside the DataTable card on BOTH the Dashboard (index) and the Tables page.
Wire the tab filter so switching tabs updates the live readout: clicking Finance ready must change the readout to 'Now reviewing: Finance ready · 5 items in queue'.
Keep every summary tile visible and readable: Open escalations, Finance ready, Audit complete, and Records in queue, laid out as a clean multi-tile strip on desktop.
Preserve the board copy Section workflow, Operations review queue, and the review panels (Open escalation review, Payroll variance review, Export handoff complete).

Preserve Meridian Ops Console, Dashboard, Primary Card, Warning Card, Success Card, Danger Card, Area Chart Example, Bar Chart Example, DataTable Example, Tiger Nixon, Garrett Winters, and the sidebar toggle.

Repair the styling and wiring in source (SCSS + JS + Pug), not by editing generated dist output only, and do not remove or restructure the dashboard cards, charts, DataTable include, chart demo scripts, or navigation links.
Ground the repair in the existing SB Admin / Bootstrap visual language: bordered light tiles, muted uppercase labels, a readable readout chip, and compact table-adjacent spacing.
design_constraints: Keep the native SB Admin / Bootstrap 5 dashboard style: dark top nav and side nav, Bootstrap cards, small admin headings, muted helper copy, bordered light panels, and compact table-adjacent spacing.
The fix is a section-level repair of the review-queue workflow inside the existing DataTable card, not a replacement hero, modal, new route, or detached custom app.
Do not alter package scripts, chart script includes, DataTable include, sidebar toggle, chart cards, KPI cards, or navigation links.

Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow after the repair, the summary tiles must overlap nothing and stay legible, and the tab readout must reflect the selected queue.

Ground the repair in the template's own local assets and visual states: reuse the vendored assets/vendor CSS/JS (Bootstrap, Chart.js, Simple-DataTables, FontAwesome) and the existing bordered-tile / muted-uppercase-label imagery, and verify the fix in the captured desktop, tablet, and mobile review-queue visual states rather than introducing new images or placeholder media.
state_constraints: desktop_initial checks the dashboard first view remains intact and free of horizontal overflow, with the queue workflow present.
desktop_review_queue scrolls to the Operations review queue and checks it renders as a clean multi-tile strip with a legible readout on desktop.
desktop_queue_finance clicks the Finance ready tab and checks the live readout updates to the Finance ready queue.
desktop_tables_queue checks the queue workflow is also present in the DataTable card on the Tables page.
tablet_initial checks the dashboard on an intermediate viewport with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_initial checks the 390px mobile dashboard has no horizontal overflow after the tile row wraps.
mobile_review_queue scrolls to the queue on mobile and checks the tiles wrap into a clean, legible column.
mobile_sidebar_open checks the mobile sidebar toggle still works and the mobile layout stays free of horizontal overflow.

change_completion: The 390px mobile dashboard (mobile_initial, mobile_review_queue, mobile_sidebar_open) has no horizontal overflow after the tile row wraps.
Clicking the Finance ready tab updates the live readout to 'Now reviewing: Finance ready · 5 items in queue' rather than leaving it frozen on Open escalations.
design_consistency: The repaired workflow keeps the SB Admin / Bootstrap visual language: bordered light tiles, muted uppercase labels, a readable readout chip, compact spacing.
The Operations review queue workflow appears in the DataTable card on both the Dashboard and the Tables page (shared cross-page component).
responsive: Desktop, tablet, mobile initial, and mobile review-queue states have no horizontal overflow.
The summary tiles remain readable, fully visible, and non-overlapping on 390px mobile and on desktop.
regression: The original top nav, sidebar toggle, KPI cards, chart cards, DataTable Example, sample rows, chart scripts, and navigation links remain visible and usable.
The patch does not change package scripts, remove chart assets, alter the DataTable include, or replace the dashboard shell.
evaluation_rubric.scoring_notes: A correct patch is a small source-level repair of the review-queue workflow: wrap the tile row (SCSS), restore the workflow on the Tables page (Pug), and make the tab readout recompute on click (JS). Patches that merely clip overflow (overflow-x:hidden on a fixed-width nowrap row), let the tiles overlap/shingle into an illegible pile, leave the readout frozen on the initial queue, or omit the workflow from the Tables page should fail the no-overflow, visual-regression, interaction, or cross-page DOM checks.
